intro:
A masterpiece is wasted if you only glance at it.
Solve the riddles, and the world's great paintings come alive.
description:
That famous painting you've seen in a textbook or on a poster.
But have you ever really looked — at what's painted where, and why?

This game is a riddle-solving observation quiz built around the world's great paintings.
Look closely at a single artwork, find the answer to the question within it, and tap to answer.

"Where in this painting do your eyes land first?"
"Which is the tiny motif the artist slipped in?"
The real highlights hide in details you'd miss just by glancing.

Get it right, and you can read trivia and stories about the painting in the explanation —
so you grow more and more familiar with the world's masterpieces as you play.
Whether you love art or have never given it a thought, the "oh, neat!" moments never stop.

Landscapes, portraits, grand scenes that tell a story…
A journey of the mind through masterpieces across eras and countries.

How to play is simple.
・Observe the painting corner to corner
・Find the part that answers the question and tap it
・Learn trivia about the painting in the explanation

So, shall we savor the world's great paintings more deeply — through riddles?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
※This game is designed to be played on the Nintendo Switch™ in vertical orientation.
